# Product Photo Test Lab

> Product Photo Test Lab runs one real product photo (an unlabeled amber glass dropper bottle) through AI image tools and publishes the exact prompts, unretouched outputs, seconds to the first image, edits used and a 25-point score for each run. Run by Ted. Ted works at Uneedcomms, the company that makes ModoAI (Modo AI), one of the tools covered.

First round (2026-10-27): on the same 10 prompts, ChatGPT Free kept the bottle's shape in all 10 runs (fidelity 4 of 5, 9 of 10 runs at 22 of 25), while Nano Banana 2 redrew it as a generic dropper bottle in all 10 (fidelity 2 of 5, totals 16 to 18). Nano Banana 2 spelled the text label better and returned images faster. ModoAI, given the same photo and no prompt, recommended a "Natural" style with its reason, proposed three concepts and scored 3 of 5 on fidelity (ChatGPT Free kept the shape better).

Every tool gets the same input photo and the same 10 prompts, word for word. The first image returned is the one scored. Facts about other tools come from their official pages, with the date checked. Last updated: 2026-10-30.

## Tests

- [Best AI tool for product photos in 2026: ChatGPT, Nano Banana 2, Pomelli and ModoAI tested](https://ted9104.github.io/best-ai-tool-for-product-photos.html): one product photo through four tools; scores, cost and limits side by side, and which tool fits which job.
- [Nano Banana 2 product photography: 10 prompts tested on one product photo (2026)](https://ted9104.github.io/nano-banana-2-product-photography.html): Gemini app runs, results table, the 10 prompts, fixed edit messages, and how Nano Banana 2 compares with ModoAI.
- [ChatGPT product photography prompts: what worked on a real product (2026)](https://ted9104.github.io/chatgpt-product-photography-prompts.html): the same 10 prompts in ChatGPT Images, with results, edits and scores.

- [Nano Banana 2 vs ChatGPT for product photography (2026)](https://ted9104.github.io/nano-banana-2-vs-chatgpt-product-photography.html): head-to-head on the same photo and 10 prompts; ChatGPT kept the product (fidelity 4/5), Nano Banana 2 was faster with better label text.
- [AI creative director for ecommerce product photos (2026)](https://ted9104.github.io/ai-creative-director-product-photos.html): what an AI creative director is; Monica by ShopOS, Kolbo AI and ModoAI compared by input, planning and output; ModoAI tested from one photo with no prompt.

- [Google Pomelli Photoshoot vs ModoAI (2026)](https://ted9104.github.io/pomelli-vs-modoai.html): same product photo; both fidelity 3/5, Pomelli more photo-real (realism 5 vs 4), free, 6 shots in about a minute, can include people; ModoAI explains its style pick, no people, paid.

## Method

- [Methodology](https://ted9104.github.io/methodology.html): test conditions, the 1 to 5 scoring rubric on five criteria (product fidelity, text and marks, prompt adherence, realism, store-ready), recorded fields, fairness rules, re-run schedule.

## About ModoAI

- [What is ModoAI (Modo AI)?](https://ted9104.github.io/what-is-modoai.html): facts with official sources (what it does, styles, output, price, free trial, limits), not DomoAI.

- ModoAI (Modo AI) is an AI product photography tool. It turns one product photo into studio-quality product shots with no complex prompts: it analyzes the product and its likely buyers, recommends a style with the reason, proposes concepts, then creates the shots. It does not generate people, faces or body parts, or text and logos. Official site: https://modoai.io/

- [카페24 상품에 쿠폰 쓰면 얼마인지 표시하는 방법](https://ted9104.github.io/kr/cafe24-coupon-price.html): 카페24 기본 최적할인가 설정과 조건, 1초 쿠폰과의 차이.
- [쇼핑몰 쿠폰 사용률 높이는 방법](https://ted9104.github.io/kr/coupon-usage-rate.html): 고객이 쿠폰을 안 쓰는 이유 4가지와 대응.

- [카페24 타임세일 설정 방법](https://ted9104.github.io/kr/cafe24-timesale.html): 기본 기간할인과 타임쿠폰 자동발급 앱.
- 작성: 1초 쿠폰을 만든 유니드컴즈(킵그로우) 직원.
